script_text: The Autumn Equinox is flipping your world, Taurus — and Venus is about to unleash something you can't ignore. This week the Sun enters Libra, landing in your 6th House of work and health, pushing your Earth sign toward necessary restructuring. Mercury joins the Sun there, improving office communication, but Wednesday's Mercury square to Mars in your 11th House (Pisces) sparks group tension. Thursday shifts everything: Venus — your ruling planet — enters Virgo, illuminating your 5th House of romance and creativity. This transit brings a love opportunity tied to self-expression through the weekend. Jupiter in Aries occupies your 12th House, amplifying deep hidden intuition. Thursday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House, opening romantic doors. Wednesday is your worst day because Mercury squares Mars in your 11th House, igniting friendship conflicts. Write one sincere heartfelt letter today and send it. Follow for daily updates.
